date.clue: Identical twin of George Sr., who was born on September 24, 1940. No record names Oscar's own birth date.

title: The frozen banana stand opens
description: The family's account is that the stand opened in 1953, though a ribbon-cutting ceremony was held in 1963. George took the idea from a Korean immigrant, whom Lucille later had deported.

title: Lindsay born
description: Born Nellie. Her real birthday is unknown.

date.clue: She is three years older than Michael, who was born in December 1967.
The eldest son. His parents married in February 1965, when Lucille was already expecting him, and Michael followed in December 1967. No record gives his birth date.

title: George Sr. and Lucille marry
description: A civil ceremony at Newport Beach, recorded in Orange County. Lucille was working as a waitress and was already expecting G.O.B.; she had been with George's twin Oscar before, and Oscar signed as a witness.

title: Michael Bluth born
description: His birth certificate reads "Nichael" because of a typo.

title: George Sr. and Lucille adopt Lindsay
description: They adopted her before their rival Stan Sitwell could, and raised her as Michael's twin.

date.clue: She was adopted at the age of three and was born around 1964.

title: George Sr. and Lucille start Cinco de Cuatro
description: A holiday held on the eve of the fifth of May.

date.clue: He was found to be 18 years old in 2004, the year he was adopted.

title: Michael and Tracey marry
description: During Michael's second year of college.

title: Tracey Bluth dies
description: Of ovarian cancer, in the family beach cottage, after several months in a coma.

title: The Fünkes move back to California
description: From Boston, after Tobias lost his job and his medical licence in Massachusetts.

title: G.O.B. is expelled from the Alliance of Magicians
description: The group he founded threw him out after a television reporter revealed the secret of one of his illusions.

title: George Sr. is arrested at his retirement party
description: The SEC arrested him aboard the Marina Hornblower for fraud at the Bluth Company. The investigation for "light treason" over homes built in Iraq came later.

title: Michael takes over the Bluth Company
description: He stayed on to run the company after his father's arrest.

title: The banana stand burns down
description: There was $250,000 in cash lining its walls. Accounts differ on who lit it and why: one says Michael burned it in protest, another that George Michael did to hide missing money.

title: George Sr. and Lucille adopt Annyong
description: Through the Korean Consulate of Child Services, to look more charitable to the SEC.

title: Tobias and Lindsay try an open marriage
Buster joins the Army
description: Lucille signed him up when a Michael Moore impersonator dared her to.

title: Buster loses his left hand to a seal
description: A seal in a bow tie bit it off while he swam in the ocean, which excused him from service for a time. He later wore a hook, and then a large bionic hand from the Army.

title: Oscar is jailed in his twin's place
description: George shaved Oscar's head and turned him in as George Bluth. No record gives the date.

title: Oscar serves in Vietnam
description: He was a "croc spotter" on a swift boat, and met Lucille there through the USO. No record gives the years.

title: George Michael and Maeby marry by accident
description: They took part in what they believed was a pretend wedding for elderly hospital patients. The priest was real and the marriage was official.

title: Lindsay learns she was adopted
description: She also learned that she is three years older than she had believed.

title: George Sr. moves out of the penthouse
description: Under the guise of a divorce from Lucille. The divorce was not real.

title: Lucille takes the Queen Mary out to sea
description: During the party for George's exoneration. The ship capsized, and Lucille was arrested for sinking it.

title: George Michael presents Fakeblock
description: A wood-block sound app that rumour turned into privacy software. He presented it as George Maharis.

title: Lindsay runs for Congress
description: On the Republican ticket, after the support for a speech she gave in Herbert Love's absence. Sally Sitwell took over the other side of the race from Lucille Austero.

title: Lucille Austero dies at Cinco de Cuatro
description: She went missing during the festival and was at first only presumed dead. Her body was found later, and Buster admitted to pushing her down the stairs.
